normalization: Unicode NFKD, remove combining accents, uppercase; normalize curly apostrophes; tokens match [A-Z0-9]+(?:'[A-Z0-9]+)*. Other punctuation/hyphens separate words. No number expansion, spelling correction, or reference-driven rewriting.
cache_key: SHA256 of exact float32 mono samples at 16kHz
limitations: one recognizer, not a human word-deletion diagnosis
test not used for checkpoint selection
